entities.summary: Sir George William Ross was an educator and politician in the Canadian province of Ontario. He was the fifth premier of Ontario from 1899 to 1905. He previously served as Ontario’s minister of education from 1883 to 1899, overseeing major expansion and centralization of the provincial school system.
